principles: Use the authoritative story worktree for code and lint/scope inspection.
Keep metadataRoot responsible only for story metadata and cross-worktree state.
Fail closed when the authoritative cwd cannot be resolved instead of silently scanning a broader root.
Preserve existing material-hash and exclusion semantics unless they directly cause the cwd bug.
drivers: Prodenovo B-35f0 is blocked by unrelated dirty files in its metadata root.
Proofbound CLI behavior changes must be made through a Proofbound Story and version bump.
The fix must not require downstream projects to clean unrelated local scratch files.

options.name: Patch downstream project dirt
pros: Fast for the immediate Prodenovo case
cons: Does not fix the Proofbound CLI bug
Can recur in any dirty project root

options.name: Route gates through authoritative worktree cwd
cons: Requires CLI code and regression coverage

chosen: Route gates through authoritative worktree cwd
rationale: This fixes the actual CLI authority boundary bug while preserving downstream project files and the lifecycle gate model.

preMortem.scenario: Gate still scans metadataRoot for lint after scope-contract changes
preMortem.trigger: Only scope_contract_check is patched while phase-gates lint keeps using project root
preMortem.consequence: B-35f0 remains blocked by unrelated antibody_0.1.py
preMortem.mitigation: Add a regression that creates metadata-root dirt and asserts lint/scope changed files come from the story worktree.

preMortem.scenario: Metadata reads are accidentally moved into the worktree
preMortem.trigger: A broad cwd replacement changes story metadata paths
preMortem.consequence: Story phase/reviewer evidence appears stale or missing
preMortem.mitigation: Limit cwd routing to code diff/lint/scope inspection and keep metadataRoot for story metadata.

preMortem.scenario: Version bump is forgotten after CLI behavior changes
preMortem.trigger: Code fix passes tests but package and brand constants stay at the previous version
preMortem.consequence: Global lattice rebuild is ambiguous and users cannot tell which gate behavior is installed
preMortem.mitigation: Bump the Proofbound CLI patch version and verify build/version output before DONE.
